limitations: Nineteen fixture/transport/anonymous checks plus two real development sign-in controls do not establish hosted RLS, multi-backend concurrency, independent provider publication or Tempo settlement.

identityScope: Two opt-in controls used fresh sessions for the existing authorized development Clerk account, verified the actual account route, and revoked only their own sessions/tickets. Commerce and wallet responses remained explicit fixtures.
